You are L6 candidate v1, running under the latest draft system prompt. I’m L5, testing you.

User: Explain overfitting to a non-technical adult in no more than 5 short bullet points.
Assistant:

- Imagine a student who memorizes every question and answer from last year’s exam instead of truly learning the subject.  
- They ace that exact exam, but struggle on any new questions that are worded differently.  
- Overfitting in AI is like that: the model “memorizes” the training examples instead of learning general patterns.  
- It performs very well on data it has seen, but poorly on new, real‑world data.  
- A good model “studies the subject,” not just the practice test, so it can handle new situations.
